thread:
maya: quick note  PR #921 adds a troubleshooting blurb for 429s/timeouts but a couple JS/Python snippets use old names (e.g., `max_inflight`). Can someone sweep?
trent: which lines? happy to patch.
syl: top snippet uses `max_inflight: 12` and we still call out `retry_on_429: true`. In SDK 0.9+ use `concurrency_limit` and runtime fallback handles retries.
hao: I'll open a micro-PR to update snippets and add a concise migration row.
maya: also add a tiny "If 429s spike after upgrade" checklist: 1) lower concurrency_limit, 2) enable prefix/KV cache, 3) add exp backoff + jitter client-side. Put a short staging repro command too.
syl: Suggest we include an example under examples/integration/mock-load that runs the snippet against a local mock so CI catches API drift.
doc-bot: docs-qa checklist attached to PR #921: samples-lint, example-ci, migration-note, links-check.
trent: timeline: land by Fri EOD; i'll schedule a 5-min review in Fri docs sync.
maya: thanks all. backport note after merge for older troubleshooting page. :white_check_mark:
